This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard Mr.B.Mohanty, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners and Mr.Arupananda Das,
learned Addl Govt. Advocate appearing for the State of Odisha.

The petitioners have filed this writ petition seeking for a direction to the Collector & District Magistrate, Jharsuguda, opposite party no.2 to pay compensation with all the statutory benefits to the petitioners within a stipulated time by strictly adhering to the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 for acquisition of land in Mouza Katarbaga, Khata No. 135 pertaining to Plot No. 136 area Ac.
0.5900 dec stands recorded in the name of the father of the petitioners and another land at Mouza Katarbaga, Khata No. 141/4 pertaining to Plot No. 53 measuring Ac 1.6600 dec stands recorded in the name of petitioner No.1.

entities.text: Jhas Kumar Khamari vs State Of Odisha & ..... Opp. Parties on
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that highlighting the grievances, the petitioners have made a representation to the Collector & District Magistrate, Jharsuguda, opposite party no.2 on 27.08.2024 under Annexure-5 for consideration, but the same is still pending with the opposite party no.2 and therefore, a direction may be given to the opposite party no.2 to dispose of the said representation within a specified period.
Learned counsel for the State has no objection to such submission.

Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the respective parties, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case so also the representation filed, we dispose of the writ petition directing the Collector &
District Magistrate, Jharsuguda, opposite party no.2 to take a decision on the representation filed by the petitioners vide Annexure-5 in accordance with law and to pass appropriate order within a period of three months from the date of production of a certified copy of this order by the petitioners.
The order shall be communicated to the petitioners by the opposite party no.2 within two weeks of taking decision.
Issue urgent certified copy as per Rules.
( S.K. Sahoo) Judge (Chittaranjan Dash) Judge PKSahoo
